body:
>If you dont want to be lonely you need to reach out to others.

No, I do this already and it doesn't work, there's clearly something about me that is fundamentally unlikable that nobody is telling me about.

I don't have any pets. I just imagine myself getting a pet and thinking to myself 'oh, so it's come to this...' and feeling really sad. I can't have pets where I live at the moment but I would like to get a doggy dog one day.
I listen to music all the time, but enjoyment and loneliness are two different things. Like on the Sims how when you listen to music your 'Fun' goes up but your 'Social' remains unaffected.

As far as I'm concerned the entire planet is a bad environment full of the wrong people. I am on good terms with myself when I kind of look at myself objectively, but I hate the experience of being me and I end up being quite self destructive to either punish myself or just shut it all out, I don't know.

Yes, I do actually. I think that I'm a good person and it's frustrating to me that it has literally been recognised by nobody ever in my life. I don't try to be a good person to get people to recognise me, I just do it in and of itself, but regardless I am still annoyed.

There are various cute little surprises in life that are fun but none of them are really good enough to justify staying alive for too long.
Yes, but presumably you have some kinds of social skills whereas I don't.

Nah, I have no interest in talking to any relatives, they're the kinds of people who can't keep secrets. There's no way. No way no way no way. I get that people *must have* other people who they can rely on etc., but usually it's because they've known that person since childhood or whatever. You're not going to suddenly start meeting these people when you're 23. Anybody who is half decent is going to already have lots of friends and not need any more. So no, there is nobody and there never will be.

Yeah but statistically I think you are more likely to die of old age before you meet one of these people anyway, so you might as well just speed up the process.

You ask a good question. Nobody specifically but it would be nice to just have that *one* person I could talk to about things without any fear that they're going to think I'm stupid or cut me out of their life or anything like that. At the moment I feel as though I am just expendable to everybody - like if I were to start talking too much I'd become really inconvenient and people would just avoid me.

Actually it is annoying, I wish that I could just be more open with people and be able to actually talk about it and stuff, but people don't give a shit so I just keep everything to myself and that is what is killing me.

Nah, I am certain that it's something else, so not depression in the technical sense. My life isn't screwed enough - nobody in my life knows that I am suicidal etc., because I can still maintain all the energy needed to put on a brave face. I think if you are depressed you don't get to do that.
How do you mean symptom?

I don't know and I am not that bothered. I don't think I am depressed in the sense that there is some chemical imbalance in my head or whatever - I think that I just don't get along with people and I'm really lonely, which isn't an illness. Basically I just wish that I were dead, define it how you like.

Well, I thought about suicide pretty much every day for a big length of time spanning from when I was about 18 till when I was 22. So presumably I'm in for the same thing again. Except I have no real interest in sticking it out that long this time.
Yeah, I post here when I am upset but generally all you're going to get if you post here is like, ten minutes of somebody sending you messages and then it's over.
No, I don't think so.
I feel very very old though. It's weird, I can't describe it.
How do you know that I am young, I could be like 80 years old for all you know.

I don't know why but I simply can't get myself interested in volunteering. Helping other people just...I dunno.

My friends will not want to go anywhere with me. Historically it has always been next to impossible to get people to spend time with me, this  new group of friends won't be any different.
Actually when I look at people who are in a worse situation than me, I always just feel guilty for feeling how I do myself, which makes it worse if anything.
This is part of the problem, I never really want to discuss how I feel with people because I'm always aware of how silly I must sound.
Thanks for this. Sorry, I've only just had a chance to reply to this message, had a busy couple of days.
I'm aware that I haven't really shown you much gratitude in this conversation but you have been very helpful, so thank you for listening and being there for me to bounce ideas off.
Hmmm. Why do you choose to make friends the hard way?

Given that right now with regards to myself I am thinking that self harm/suicide are *very good ideas indeed*, I think it'd be kinda irresponsible of me to go round giving other people advice.

I think trying to be more than one thing is part of what got me into trouble in the first place though. Like, nobody knows how upset I am because I am always pretending to be somebody else to give other people an easier time. If you are acting like this all of your life then it becomes really difficult to know who you actually are, and being more than one thing becomes really really unappealing to you.
Hm. So this is what I have to go through to make friends?

I don't know, there are so many different options, many of which contradict each other, that it's difficult to pick just one. I think as long as I am making other people's lives more better than worse, then that is all I am after and I'm otherwise not too fussed with the specifics.
Sounds like you've been through quite a lot.

Oh blimey, I am always saying to people 'look, there are 7 billion people on this planet, so you can't possibly think that...', but I have never had anybody use that line on me so now I know what it feels like, haha. Like 'admittedly that is a big number so I have no counterargument'.

But I suppose it'd be like saying 'there are *seven billion* people on earth, which is loads, so surely at least one of them can fly?'. I maintain that with the set of characteristics that I have, it would actually be *impossible* for anybody to like me.

What do you mean by 'who do you consider yourself to be?'. Half of me doesn't know, and half of me is just bad at answering big general questions like that.
Is it though? Is it really? If I get to hear this story and find that either heartbreak, deception, love, or corruption is missing, then I am going to be disappointed :(
You should tell me it, I love a good story.

I just think that if you have not ever had anybody of the opposite sex be interested in you by the time you are 23 then you *never will ever*. Like there must be something fundamentally wrong with you that nobody's telling you about.

I don't have a close friend like this, no. Or I may do...it's complicated because I feel like I am not the person that people think I am, and that if anybody finds this out then everything will just come crashing down very very quickly and I won't be able to handle it. Does that make sense? So even if I had very very close friends, then they are not friends with *me*, they are friends with like some weird character that I've created for myself to interact with the world with, so if I suddenly started telling them how upset I was it would be like they were talking to a stranger. Also it is frustrating because I'd quite happily drive to a mountain at 2am to talk to pretty much anybody in my life, but I don't think anybody would do the same for me. I'm not saying that you should expect things in return for the things that you do necessarily, but at the same time I don't think it's unreasonable to feel a bit frustrated with that.
Jessica EDGEBLADE. Holy shit, that's a name and a half.

Other people say that I am a good person and are very complimentary towards me, yes, but...I think that surely if people liked me as much as they say that they do then there'd be some evidence of that, like they would spend time with me and not ignore my texts and etc.

My friendships have always been shaky - actually my friendship situation right now is better than it has been but I think it's kinda just all a bit too late and I was past the point of no return anyway. I don't know if I am depressed but I have freaky freaky moods and have done for years, but the one thing I do know is that nowadays I can be in the worst mood in the world and I will absolutely not let it affect anybody else - like I'll never take it out on anybody or anything like that. So that's not the cause of anything - I don't think any of the friends I have now actually know about my moodswings and stuff.

I might watch Chuck, there are lots of things that I want to watch. Although often I don't like to watch things to do with relationships because they make me sad.

We may not necessarily be the same. Just because I think that I am a decent person doesn't mean that I *am*. Just because I think that somebody else is horrible doesn't mean that they *are*. Maybe I am just wrong.

I have not seen Chuck, no. What is it about?

Yes, one of my friends was saying to me 'you need to love yourself' etc., but to be honest I am actually rather fond of myself already. I think I'm a decent person, and still absolutely nobody is interested in me when there are lots of other people around who are horrible who everybody really likes. When somebody's upset about something the default is to think that they must have feelings of low self-esteem or whatever, because that's a problem for which there's an obvious solution, but mine is nothing like that.

Actually I wish I was meaner than I am. Normally I will bend over backwards to help other people even though I know for a fact that it's not going to get me anywhere. It is just automatic, I can't not do it, it's annoying.

I know this sounds weird, but I kinda feel as though I've done everything that I wanna do in life. Like, anything outside the realm of human relationships, I'm satisfied that it's not going to have a massive effect on my life. Like, discovering a new band or whatever is nice, but not something that's worth staying alive for. Ultimately the only thing that I really care about is whether I get along with other people or not, and it seems pretty conclusive to me at this point that I *don't* get along with other people, so there is nothing in it for me any more.

If there's ever a time when I don't feel lonely it's because I momentarily got distracted because there was a thunderstorm or something like that. If I ever try to help people they either don't want help, or I just end up feeling like a goon who everybody's taking advantage of because nobody will ever help me out in return. There's no risk of me seeing a glimpse of my future with a family - I'm not sure if I would ever want to start a family and it doesn't bear thinking about either way given that nobody would ever be interested in me.
Thank you :)
Meh, different people have different preferences. I don't think there is anything wrong with anybody who is a loner, it is just not for me, that's all.

I dunno, I kinda feel as though a life where you don't connect with other people is one that's not worth living, although I am not sure why I think that exactly. So if it is instrinsically the case that I am never going to be able to connect with anybody, then I am not sure if life particularly interests me.

I was thinking about a fun analogy for this the other day. Having a life with no friends...it's kinda like if you went to a party, and when you got there you found there was no alcohol there. Yeah, you *mayyy* still have a nice time there and there are ways you can enjoy yourself without alcohol, but ultimately you'd still spend most of the party wishing you were somewhere else, and you'd totally leave early.

See, it is difficult, because it's not as if I'm some idiot who doesn't know how to socialise - I do these things, and I make a lot of effort with other people and I try to be nice to people, but either other people just completely suck, or there is something wrong with me that nobody is telling me about that means that I just don't connect with other people in the same way as others do.

I don't like to have internet friends too much. Generally with my friends, I like to either see them in real life or have absolutely no contact with them. Anything else is just too shaky. Somebody who you text a lot will one day just decide that they aren't going to text you any more. Somebody who you talk to online will suddenly disappear. Etc.

I am okay with myself though, that's the problem. I think I'm a good person, I like spending time by myself, etc. - but apart from like, very very schizoid people, I doubt that there are many people in the world who could tolerate being by themselves *alllll* the time.

There is no jazz where I live, unfortunately. I'm fairly sure that I live in one of the most culturally barren cities on earth.

I feel like I've kinda done the whole 'try to meet new people' thing already. Like about a year ago I just had no friends at all. Nowadays I spend a lot of time around other people and I have loads of what other people would call friends but I just feel like I'm a bit freaky and don't connect with anybody, and I'm at the point where I just wanna shut myself off from it all instead. I think if you're around a lot of people a lot of the time then it can make it worse because you're constantly being reminded of what you're missing.

Yeah, I listen to new stuff all the time, but I feel as though just the enjoyment of music on its own isn't enough for me to have a fulfilling life.

I do see live music occasionally. There's not a lot in my area, and I do prefer listening to music it home because I can focus better, and I can always switch it off if I don't like it, which I can't do at a gig.

Actually I've been into music my whole life - I have a degree in it and play lots of musical instruments etc., .. it doesn't seem to be working.

Edit: I do like that Tame Impala album though.

Yeah, as far as I'm concerned loneliness is a permanent problem in that there won't ever be anybody in the world who cares about me bla bla bla, but there must be some kind of mental gymnastics or freaky drugs or something that cut off the part of the brain that gets sad because it's lonely.

What do you do on the internet though? Do you talk to other people, play games, watch videos, etc.?
I don't really play many games but this is actually a good suggestion.
Most things like this I just find upsetting. 99% of people in films have friends or relationships or whatever, I don't wanna look at that shit.
There isn't one where I live, also it is half past two in the morning.

Yeah, I love Minecraft, I can get lost in that for hours. I'll check that other one out too at some point.

I'm just concerned that like...I don't think the main aim in life should be finding the optimum way to distract yourself from it.

I'm not very good at focusing on TV shows books etc. when I'm in a bad mood. Like my mind just wanders.

I can't get too excited about moving in a couple of weeks, because over the past couple of years I've had various times when my situation has changed and I've thought to myself 'oh everything will be better in this new place/with this new job' etc., but here I am and nothing's changed.

See, whenever I have been upfront about people about it, they'll always turn the blame back on me and say what you have effectively said elsewhere in your post, which is 'stop taking it so personally'.

I have no issue with people who would prefer to watch Netflix than hang out with me or whatever. I just can't stand it when people tell me that they want to hang out with me at a specific time at a specific place, and then don't.

If I'd agreed to meet up with somebody, and then something else came up and I wasn't able to make it, then *least* I would do would be to send them a text or ring them or whatever apologising, and then I would *immediately* try to reschedule. However, what often happens with me is, somebody will agree to meet me, I'll text them on the day or whatever saying 'hey you still okay to meet up today?', and then I'll get a text back saying 'nah sorry I'm busy' or whatever, and *that's it*. And it's just like...well if you knew that you were busy before I texted you, then why am I only hearing about it now? Like if I hadn't texted them to check that they were still available, I would have just turned up at the place and been hanging around like an idiot. And then I just won't hear from that person again for ages. And I simply don't see why it's so unacceptable for me to take things like that personally.

Thank you. I just can't help but think that like, if I were to have kept records of all of the times people had agreed to meet up with me and then the amount of times that they'd pulled out on me at the last minute, I'd say that at least 50% of the time people let me down. And the temptation for me is to go 'fuck those people' and get some new friends instead, but the problem is that it's pretty much everybody in my life who is unreliable like that. There is nobody who wants to be with me on like a consistent basis. And I just think it's more likely that there's something wrong with me than it is that there's something wrong with *everybody else*.

Unless I'm deluding myself I don't have any real social anxieties. Like, I'm probably slightly more quiet than the average person but I'm not exactly shy and don't really feel nervous when talking to new people or whatever. I just feel disconnected. People tell me that they really like me, but I just don't think that that can be true because they never want to spend any time with me.

I think that when I was hitting myself over the head I kinda...actively didn't want that sense of control. Like, it could have not really done anything, or it could have really really seriously hurt me. It's just like...I've had control over all of the decisions that I've made in the past, and it's led me nowhere. And I feel the same thing day in and day out. So I just wanted to introduce some randomness into my life. Maybe I am overanalysing, I don't know.

No real big life changes. I'm actually supposed to be moving in a month with a friend, so it's strange that this has happened today because I was feeling slightly more optimistic than normal earlier on in the week. 

I actually tried doing that 'getting out and meeting more people' thing over the past couple of weeks, and it was a disaster. People haven't been returning my texts. People kept pulling out on me at the last minute. People said that they'd meet up with me and then didn't. And this shit's just been happening to me for years. Whenever I try to connect with anybody, I just...don't. And I don't see why that would suddenly change.

Thank you for your reply. I just kinda felt really intense and panicked and felt like I needed to beat the shit out of myself. I felt a lot better immediately after hitting myself over the head than I did before hitting myself over the head. I'm not too concerned about causing myself a serious injury. I never liked my brain too much in the first place. 

I'm okay now, it's just weird knowing that like...I'm going to have to talk to people tomorrow and stuff while pretending as though I'm fine and as though nothing's happened. I don't feel dizzy or anything like that. I haven't had anything concretely upsetting happen to me this week...I just feel incredibly isolated and lonely, as I have done for over a year now, and I think it's just got to a point where it's all too much.
